description: Global Energy Monitor’s Global Methane Emitters Tracker combines estimated annual methane emissions from fossil-fuel infrastructure with attribution of remotely sensed methane plumes. The December 2025 release covers coal mines, pipelines, LNG terminals and oil/gas extraction areas worldwide, with separate plume records and infrastructure identifiers. Its documented workbook has named data tabs and a field dictionary; plume emissions use kilograms per hour. Public maps and downloadable data are free. GEM’s general default is CC BY 4.0, but its own release metadata explicitly place the Plumes tab under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, with additional Carbon Mapper terms for specified columns. A limitation is that annual emission-factor estimates generally do not incorporate the individual plume observations, and oil/gas fields do not necessarily match Climate TRACE assets one-to-one. Simulation uses include emissions scenarios, source attribution and linking environmental impacts to asset inventories. It complements data-gem-global-coal-mine-tracker and data-gem-global-gas-infrastructure-tracker. No matching catalogue or first-review draft was identified. The workbook metadata and methodology were inspected; no methane data were downloaded.
